description: Effective immediately, most non-immigrant and non-diplomatic visas issued to Nigerian citizens became single-entry with three months' validity. The schedule was updated at the same time for Cameroon, Ethiopia and Ghana; at least 26 countries have seen validity reduced.
energy_note: Five years, reduced to twelve weeks, overnight.

description: Leaving the US at all - even briefly to a neighbouring country - means needing an entirely new visa stamp abroad before returning, regardless of whether the job or course is ongoing.
money_note: New application, fee and travel, per re-entry.
energy_note: One trip home, and you may not get back.

description: Nigeria is America's seventh largest source of international students, sending over 20,000 in 2023/24. After three months a student must obtain a new visa each time they re-enter, with the fee each time.
energy_note: Twenty thousand students, each re-applying to go home for Christmas.

description: New non-immigrant visa issuance was suspended from 1 January 2026 and immigrant visas from 21 January 2026. Reporting referenced a cable citing 36 countries considered for travel bans, and a court intervention over paused immigrant visa issuance for nationals of 75 countries including Nigeria.
energy_note: Not a harder queue. A closed window.

description: Nigeria's presidential spokesperson said Nigeria continued to offer five-year multiple-entry visas to US nationals, refuting the claim that the change was reciprocal. The State Department framed its criteria around secure travel documents, overstay rates and information sharing.
energy_note: Called reciprocity, and reciprocated by nobody.

aspect: The planning horizon collapses to one trip
description: A multi-year visa lets a person accept a two-year posting, enrol in a three-year course, or plan a wedding abroad. A three-month single entry supports one journey and no commitments beyond it.
energy_note: You can plan exactly one trip at a time.
